test_title: PYST 49: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 6th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fourth number in the same way as the first number is related to the second number.

36 : 9 :: ? : 16
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• 36 : 9 → 36 ÷ 4 = 9

Similarly,

 
• ? : 16 → ? ÷ 4 = 16
 
• ⇒ ? = 16 × 4
 
• ⇒ ? = 64

Hence, '**64**' is the correct answer.
